title: Interactions of conformal and partially massless higher spin fields
summary: This thesis investigates the interactions of partially massless (PM) fields in 4-dimensional (anti)de Sitter spaces, along with conformal higher spin fields and their coupling to matter in arbitrary dimensions. The first part of the thesis deals with PM fields and PM algebras. A reformulation of PM fields is proposed and studied using a novel chiral formulation, inspired by Penrose's twistor approach to massless fields in Minkowski space.
